## Fresh integrated scope and independence

This is a new final whole-change assessment of ffb58ecb2b8879926eaa1db0784761768ffb303e through bb281e34, not carry-forward of milestone approval. Current context has completed M1/M2; approved proposal, Skill/System Design r2 and Delivery r2 remain the requirement/allocation basis. Reviewer authored none of those engineering contributions, implementation, tests, generated metadata or preservation correction. Prior Design and milestone reviews were independent assessment only. This invocation reread the full final diff by responsibility, the approved TG-FINAL-01 boundary, actual candidate entry procedures/references/assets, current records/proof, and source/consumer/follow-up interactions. No engineering or routing changes were made.

## Integrated findings and supported conclusions

The final pair offers a useful classification-first improvement: an ordinary author sees purpose, role, evidence/target and invocation classification before storage construction, then uses the existing seven-section asset with conditional impact. It needs no lifecycle record or owning pointer without project authority. Formal independent assessment selects durable procedure, complete proposal/intent, scoped context, exact subjects, native review/finding writes, conflict/recovery and correct asset groups. The actual Codex candidate supplies core, durable and formal result groups; automated and specialized groups remain conditional. Adopted assessment precedence comes from its complete packaged application; the unadopted scope-defect rule remains explicitly scoped. Missing/late-required content stops dependent work, while package checks reject even untriggered absent resources. No author self-approval, isolated automatic continuation or customer policy adoption follows.

TG-FINAL-01 cross-milestone composition is sound except the recorded corrections. A moved body heading cannot bypass profile checking: exact selected references and body triggers are required; an unrelated complete resource cannot rescue a missing selected method. Candidate placement stays v2. All 11 pilot resources match canonical raw bytes in each supported archive, independently checked in this invocation. All 32 current proof engineering hashes match. Of 137 canonical files, exactly the four intended pilot files changed and 133 remain byte-identical. The suffix after CI's immutable engineering snapshot contains only attributable change-owned JSON records. Current metadata/archive checks and Gate B support the claimed candidate, not live installation/publication.

The current Skill table precisely retains metadata/profile fields, role fields and two-line summary, closed stage vocabulary, once-only vocabulary presentation/approved reference equivalent, usable output shapes, public lint populations and contributor exclusions, recognized legacy prefixes, fail-or-approved-temporary-exception, immediate new/changed versus inventory enforcement, and full-read escapes. Retained common applicability is not newly imposed on all skills; consolidation does not certify their conformance. Specialist methods, asset families and policy remain with named owners. Mixed source retains R37–45/R56–63 with historical rollout and superseded runtime proof bounded. Architecture common sections and current navigation point to Skill, while Gate B/installer/release remain separate. Exact originals, archive provenance, source-path retention and 73 accessible related targets preserve history. Operational paths remain intact. FU-015–018 allocate all 17 remaining capabilities with receiving owners/differences/next decisions; FU-012 retains separate validation consolidation.

Narrative relocation remains complete and contract-faithful: the eight original texts, paths and hashes are present in registered evidence; old note subjects retain historical identity and current reliance uses exact implemented subjects plus preserved entries. No old judgment is retargeted. Tests that referenced historical prose now explicitly preserve history, while current-owner protection and actual validator mutation tests cover the surviving behavior. No test deletion or inventory rewrite was introduced.

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Error handling | pass | Package/profile failures are explicit; no silent fallback, recording approval or resource invention. Failed integration executions remain visible. |
| Architecture boundaries | concern | Common/specialist ownership is coherent, but the stale fixture consumer must follow the selected Design legacy asset owner. |
| Compatibility | concern | Non-pilot/candidate bytes preserved; stale broad test prevents complete required validation evidence. |
| Security/privacy | pass | No new execution privilege, external action or customer adoption. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass within candidate scope | Actual three-archive resource comparisons and current proof hashes match; inspected Gate B and metadata/index checks pass. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Exact common-source/pilot/consumer scope, plus bounded narrative storage correction. No broad refactor. |
| Validation evidence | concern | Exact-head CI3 passes; broad smoke exits 1 on stale architecture fixture and an unsupported legacy changed-root adapter invocation. Their valid correction/disposition must be proved. |

## Finding skl-cr-002

- Finding ID: skl-cr-002
- Severity: minor, required before final Verify
- Location: docs/design/skill/skill.md:13, first sentence under Applicability and activation.
- Evidence: “This is a replacement Design awaiting independent assessment and implementation” is an unqualified current-state assertion after completed independent gates and M1/M2 implementation. It is not labeled historical authored context. Constitution lines 109/155 require stable governed intent and make mutable lifecycle text blocking for Verify. The following Until/At-adoption conditions are stable and valid; they do not make the preceding present-state assertion historical.
- Required outcome: Remove or replace only the stale present-state sentence with stable conditional adoption wording while preserving reviewed implementation, independent assessment and successful Verify prerequisites. Current progress remains solely in the change record.
- Safe resolution path: Design author performs the bounded prose correction, records the new exact subject and independent Design reassessment/applicability as required, then returns for fresh final Code Review. Preserve old exact-subject judgments rather than retargeting them.
- needs-decision rationale: none; existing Constitution and owning Design already select the boundary.

## Finding skl-cr-003

- Finding ID: skl-cr-003
- Severity: major
- Location: scripts/test-artifact-lifecycle-validator.py:777 and final broad validation proof.
- Evidence: Actual broad_smoke.artifact_lifecycle.regression ran 110 tests and errored because test_architecture_contract_matches_canonical_arc42_skeleton reads retired skills/architecture/assets/architecture-skeleton.md. The approved Design replacement supplies skills/design/assets/legacy-architecture-skeleton.md. The assertion of ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.required_sections never runs. The same broad invocation's changed-root legacy review adapter rejects the current v2 store; the exact-head PR path instead passed supported v2 validation.
- Required outcome: Restore the actual canonical legacy-architecture asset consumer and demonstrate the existing section-parity assertion plus all lifecycle regression cases passing. Preserve test protection and current v2-only recording validation; do not restore retired runtime adapters or waive failed evidence.
- Safe resolution path: Implementation updates only the stale test asset path to its existing Design-owned replacement and reruns the full lifecycle suite. For the broad changed-root command, document the existing supported --skip-diff-scoped mode/current exact-head v2 PR proof boundary; preserve the original failed broad result. Existing successful broad children may be reused with exact unchanged subject/environment basis and their actual results. Combine those with fresh failed-child correction proof and exact-current-subject lifecycle/record checks after the Design correction. Do not label the failed original broad invocation passing. A whole broad rerun is not required merely to manufacture a new label when all necessary protected outcomes have explicit current proof.
- needs-decision rationale: none for the bounded path fix and existing supported invocation; a new selector or runtime policy would require its owner.

## Checks actually performed and handoff

Performed final diff/status inspection, exact primary subjects/context, candidate ZIP reads of both entry files, selected recording/policy references and actual assets, Python all-canonical comparison, all 11 resource-byte checks across each of three archives, current 32-subject proof hash checks and CI-suffix classification. Inspected archived/source identities and current consumer references against the approved map; read preserved walkthrough and fresh current proof. One initial candidate lookup guessed an incorrect result-asset filename; the actual mapped assets/review-result-skeleton.md was then read successfully, so this was a reviewer lookup error, not a package defect.

Inspected exact passing CI3 command/result (boundary 12.11s/focused 299.17s), Gate B and M1/M2 tests with explicit unchanged-subject reliance. Broad smoke is actually failed, with the two concrete results above; it is not reported as successful. No universal target-agent accuracy, all-skill improved conformance, live installed currency, branch readiness or adoption is claimed. Record both findings before owner corrections; route owns their stage selection. Distinct final Verify remains blocked pending resolved concerns and fresh applicable final whole-change assessment.
